REASON: SUPERSEDES_R3_AFTER_STALE_HERMES_CHECKOUT_RECONCILIATION

SUPERSEDES_REASON: Hermes local refs were stale and did not match the published branch; no implementation or delivery may proceed from the stale cache.

SCOPE: Implement only the missing source-level F-14 workflow over the existing asset, media_operation, model access, worker and dashboard architecture. Work only in COPY_ROOT and publish only under DELIVERY_ROOT.
SYNC_GATE: Fetch SOURCE_REF before any copy. Verify PUBLISHED_COORDINATION_HEAD exists in the fetched ref and verify SOURCE_COMMIT resolves to a commit and is an ancestor of that ref. If either check fails, return terminal BLOCKED with exact command exits; do not substitute main, another branch, a release directory or a cached ref.
PASS_BOUNDARY: Source DELIVERY requires real changed source and tests, exact source binding, changed paths, per-file SHA-256, exact commands and exits, behavior evidence for every F-14 criterion and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service implementation, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider/OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
HANDOFF: Codex audits delivery bytes and tests, integrates only a passing delivery, then commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport-only. ACK/READ is not ownership; ACK/ACCEPTED establishes ownership. Every message must end with exactly one canonical signature.
sincerely, Codex
